summary: BNB Plus Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement for a convertible preferred equity private placement of up to $5M, including a securities purchase agreement with accredited investors and warrant inducement/exchange agreements with existing warrant holders. Proceeds are intended for a strategic review of its biotechnology assets and general corporate purposes, with excess funds directed to subsidiaries. The offering period runs until June 11, 2026. This is a capital-raising transaction without an explicit acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other classic special situation; thus it is classified as 'Other'.
